name: Apoorva K Singh
bio: Apoorva Kumar Singh, a 1991-batch office of the Indian Administrative Service (IAS), is presently serving as the Additional Chief Secretary to the Government of Haryana, Energy Department with the additional charge of the Town & Country Planning and Urban Estates Department. Over the course of his illustrious career, Mr Singh has held several key positions, where he demonstrated outstanding leadership and dedication to public service. An alumnus of IIT Delhi with MS from United States. He also holds LLB from Panjab University, Chandigarh and LLM (Pro) from NLU Delhi. He is an accomplished author of several books.

name: Akanksha Bisen
bio: Akanksha Bisen brings a decade of BD and marketing experience in the professional services industry, particularly law firms. Akanksha currently works with world-renowned law firm–Jones Day in its BD and Communications Department. Before moving to the States, she has worked with top-tier Indian law firms like Trilegal and Phoenix Legal, where she held leadership roles that included managing portfolios ranging from digital initiatives to media relations.

bio: Anindita Pattanayak is a lawyer with a bachelor's degree in law from the National Law School of India University, Bengaluru. She worked as a corporate lawyer and in-house counsel before pursuing a career in legal research and policy. At present, she works on judicial reforms and media accountability as a Senior Research Fellow at DAKSH.

name: Chitra Narayan
bio: Chitra Narayan is a lawyer and mediator with over 25 years of experience. She is a founding Trustee of Foundation for Comprehensive Dispute Resolution (FCDR), Chennai, an initiative to mainstream mediation and provide mediation and conciliation services. She is an accredited mediator with the Tamil Nadu Mediation and Conciliation Centre, annexed to the Madras High Court.

name: Bhumesh Verma
bio: Bhumesh Verma is the Managing Partner of Corp Comm Legal, an independent Indian law firm headquartered in New Delhi. With close to 3 decades of experience, he is one of the leading international corporate practitioners from India and among the most followed Indian lawyers on LinkedIn. In addition to his legal practice, he is an avid reader, a sought-after speaker, a guest faculty, a corporate trainer, and a prolific writer. He has contributed to the in-house journals of many international law firms on Indian laws and global books and published more than 500 articles so far.

name: Saji Narayanan C K
bio: Saji Narayanan C K is a noted lawyer, labour law expert, and former member of the Second National Commission on Labour. A prolific author of over 15 books and 250 articles, he has taught at the National Judicial Academy, Bhopal, and served in key national roles, including President of BMS and Vice-Chairperson of the Indian Labour Conference. He has led Indian trade union delegations to multiple ILO conferences and participated in international peace missions. Former President of the Thrissur Bar Association, he has also served as Director of North Malabar Gramin Bank and held positions in several national institutions.

name: Sudhir Mishra
bio: Mr. Sudhir Mishra is a leading disputes and climate change lawyer and a Door Tenant at No.5 Barristers’ Chambers, UK. He has served as Amicus Curiae in Ridhima Pandey v. Union of India, before the Supreme Court of India and had also been engaged by the Supreme Court’s Central Public Works Department to argue an IA in Bhavreen Kandhari v. Shri C D Singh & Ors. for the expansion of the Supreme Court infrastructure, before the Delhi High Court. He has been honoured at the House of Lords with the first-ever 'Guardians of Sustainability Award' as well as the 'Environmental Lawyer of the Year Award 2022', and is also a recipient of the US Government's International Visitors Leadership Programme (2005). He has been featured in the Forbes Legal Power List and has been consistently ranked among India's top 100 lawyers by the Indian Business Law Journal in 2023. He chairs leading ESG and climate change initiatives and has represented major corporations including Adani, Tata Consultancy Services, Hyundai and Tetra Pak. He has conducted 400+ workshops across 300 protected areas so far and has handled 120+ environmental cases.

name: Asheeta Regidi
bio: Asheeta Regidi is a consultant specializing in Indian and international technology, privacy and cyber laws. She has studied law at Government Law College, Mumbai (BLS, LLB), and is a Member of the Bar Council of Maharashtra and Goa. She is a Certified Information Privacy Professional (CIPP/E, CIPP/A), and a Member of the International Association of Privacy Professionals. She holds qualifications in cyber laws and cyber crime investigation from the Asian School of Cyber Laws. Asheeta provides consultation to clients, law firms and companies on matters relating to her fields of expertise. This includes consultation related to intellectual property rights in relation to software, software licensing, as well as free and open source licensing. Her other specializations include Indian and international cyber laws, privacy and data protection laws, intellectual property rights in cyberspace, and emerging issues with technology and technology policy. Several articles authored by her in her fields of specialization have been published in the media.

name: M Sricharan Rangarajan
bio: Mr M Sricharan Rangarajan is a Senior Advocate of Madras High Court. With over 17 years of experience in the Bar, he has appeared in full-bench matters and has also been appointed as amicus curiae to assist the court in matters of importance, covering diverse subjects. He has acted as an Arbitrator in both domestic and international arbitrations. He was appointed as an Additional Advocate General for the State of Tamil Nadu where he handled matters in relation to Arbitration extensively, on behalf of the State.

name: Viral Mehta
bio: Viral Mehta has over 20 years of experience in mergers and acquisitions, private equity, foreign investment, joint ventures, and general corporate matters. He is a partner at S&R Associates, one of India's leading corporate law firms, and works in its Mumbai office. He read law at Government Law College, Mumbai, and Harvard Law School.

name: Somesh Arora
bio: Mr Somesh Arora has the distinction of being the first Judicial Member, CESTAT who has a prior distinguished service with the Indian Revenue Services spanning over 25 years followed by being a practising lawyer. In his previous role he has been associated with various organizations in the Government of India including the Ministry of Finance and Ministry of Commerce. He is a practicing advocate since 2009 with specialisation in the areas of money laundering and taxation. He has also worked in various premier investigating agencies and has successfully conducted some of the leading Service Tax, Customs, Excise and FEMA investigations. He has published several articles in leading legal and tax journals and has to his credit four prior publications.

name: Sumit Pahwa
bio: eMinds Legal is a boutique Corporate Law Firm based in Gurgaon, India, specializing in Corporate Secretarial, Corporate Legal, Compliance, Accounting & Payroll. The firm comprises of a team of around 40+ professionals with in-depth subject matter knowledge and Partners having industry experience of over 20 years each. Sumit Pahwa, Partner, eMinds Legal is the lead author of the book. A Corporate Lawyer & Company Secretary, Sumit is the Co-founder of Complinity - Governance, Risk and Compliance Software. Sumit has over 20 years of experience and is an expert in Corporate Laws, Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC), and Cyber. Sumit regularly appears before the benches of National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) in relation to IBC, shareholder disputes and other matters.

name: Sriram Panchu
bio: Sriram Panchu commenced practice in 1976 at the Madras High Court and was designated a Senior Advocate in 1996. His field of law practice is constitutional and commercial law. Over the last 20 years, he has been instrumental in bringing mediation into India’s dispute resolution system. In 2005 he set up India’s first court – annexed mediation centre in the Madras High Court, and has gone on to assist the Supreme Court and other High Courts to do so. He has mediated a large number of complex and high-value commercial disputes in India and abroad.

name: SS Naganand
bio: An LLB, triple Gold Medallist, a qualified Chartered Accountant with a national merit rank to his credit, and the recipient of a ‘Living Legend of the Law’ Award conferred upon him by the Bar Association of India, SS Naganand begun his legal career spanning almost four decades, in the year 1981. He was designated Senior Advocate by the High Court of Karnataka in 2003 and is currently serving as the Vice President of the Bar Association of India. As founder and Senior Partner at Justlaw, SS Naganand’s practice spans Corporate and Commercial Laws, International Trade and Business Laws, Taxation Laws, Intellectual Property Law, Infrastructure, Power & Electricity Laws, Venture Capital Investments, Insolvency and Bankruptcy law, Arbitration, Mediation and Land Laws. This is supplemented by a strong pro bono practice that ensures that his love for the law is as alive as his strong commitment to contributing to society. SS Naganand has contributed to papers and publications on a range of subjects and topics. He is also actively involved in multifarious social initiatives.

name: Sagar Tilak
bio: Sagar Tilak is a practicing Chartered Accountant, with over a decade’s experience, specializing in tax advisory, and tax litigation. Sagar has delivered several lectures at seminars and conferences organized by various institutions including Institute of Chartered Accountants of India, Chamber of Tax Consultants, and International Fiscal Association. Sagar was specially invited to deliver a lecture on Benami Law for the Benami Cell of Income Tax Department in 2018.

name: Sudhir Kumar Katriar
bio: Justice Sudhir Kumar Katriar is a former Judge of the Patna High Court. He was enrolled as an advocate in 1973, and practised in diverse fields including civil and criminal laws, industrial & corporate laws, constitutional laws. He was elevated to the Bench of the Patna High Court in March 1999, and as a judge he delivered judgements on wide ranging issues until his retirement in 2011. He is also an avid golfer.

name: V Sudhish Pai
bio: V Sudhish Pai, Senior Advocate is a distinguished lawyer and jurist and an acclaimed author specializing in Constitutional Law and Administrative Law, having been at the Bar for over forty years. He assisted Dr. Durga Das Basu, the world-renowned commentator on constitutional law, in revising his Commentary on the Constitution of India. He is a contributor to the Restatement of Indian Law on Legislative Privileges, a project of the Supreme Court. He was Visiting Chair Professor - Asutosh Mookerjee Chair at the West Bengal National University of Juridical Sciences, Kolkata. He is a resource person at the National Judicial Academy, Bhopal for continuing legal education for judges. His contribution to academics, particularly in the area of critical constitutional analysis, has been substantial and significant. The Supreme Court and the High Courts have quoted from his writings. Sudhish Pai belongs to the illustrious class in the lineage of great commentators like Basu and Seervai whose works are monumental. Scholars like him are primarily responsible for the part played by reason and theory in the law. His role in that regard has been laudable. Through his work, he has accentuated the true meaning of the Bar as a learned profession. Ranked as a legal philosopher for his profound learning and thinking, his contribution to a healthy and informed discourse on vital public law issues is commendable.

name: Saurabh Bindal
bio: Saurabh Bindal is an advocate practising law at the Supreme Court of India and High Court of Delhi, India. Saurabh is currently leading the disputes and litigation practice of a reputed law firm as an Associate Partner. He has authored a number of books and papers on law and regularly writes columns for various newspapers. He also undertakes speaking assignments at various forums. He holds a degree in Engineering and Law.

name: Shailashri Bhaskar
bio: Shailashri Bhaskar is a Secretary in Whole Time Practice and former Deputy General Manager with SEBI, specializing in SEBI related matters and handles compliance and Corporate Governance issues of listed entities. She is a regular faculty at programs and seminars organized by the ICSI, ICAI, NISM, NSE and BSE. She is a specialist editor to the latest edition of M C Bhandari’s Guide to Company Law Procedures and has co-authored a book on the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

name: Udayan Mukerji
bio: Udayan Mukerji is a retired IPS officer and a practicing advocate with specialization in criminal matters, torts, writ petitions, arbitration and contracts. He is a Patron Member of the Bar Association of India. During his career with the IPS, he functioned at various levels dealing with homeland and internal security, communications security and investigations into security deficiencies. He is the recipient of the Indian Police Medal for Meritorious Service and the President’s Medal for Distinguished Service.

name: R K Naroola
bio: R K Naroola is a leading legal practitioner and consultant with over 36 years of experience in advising and representing corporate and individual clients. He has acquired highly specialised experience in Collaborations, Joint Ventures, Banking, Industrial Relations, Labour Law, International Financial Institutions, Foreign Trade, Contract Law and Negotiations. He has been involved in setting up of companies and Joint Ventures both in India and abroad.

name: Jonathan Rodrigues
bio: Jonathan co-founded The PACT, a firm dedicated to mediation awareness and training. Through various educational initiatives hosted by The PACT, Jonathan has been able to work with nearly 12,000 law students in India, initiating them into the world of mediation.

name: Nisshant Laroia
bio: Nisshant Laroia is a dynamic Mediator, Mediation Advocate, and Co-Founder of The PACT. He’s a law graduate from Gujarat National Law University and a GLASS scholar. He was awarded by Mr. Kiren Rijiju, Hon’ble Law Minister, Government of India, for his contribution to the field of Conflict Resolution. Nisshant’s credentials in the field of dispute resolution include being an Accredited Mediator at various prestigious institutes such as the Indian Institute of Corporate Affairs (IICA), Government of India, the Indian Institute of Arbitration and Mediation (IIAM), Edwards Mediation Academy, and a certified cross-border mediator & scholarship holder at PSMA, Charles University, Prague. He also holds the esteemed title of Accredited Mediation Advocate from SCMA London.

name: Nilendra Kumar
bio: Major General Nilendra Kumar has over 50 years of experience of working extensively across the legal space- from the government to educational institutions; international non-government agencies and corporates. He was awarded Ati Vishisht Seva Medal and Vishisht Seva Medal for his contributions as Judge Advocate General of the Indian Army, where he served for 28 years.

name: K Kannan
bio: K Kannan is a former judge of the Punjab and Haryana High Court and after his superannuation from Judicial Service in June 2016, served as Chairman of the Railway Claims Tribunal (RCT) at the Principal Bench at New Delhi, India which post he held till June 2019.

name: Puneet Bhasin
bio: Advocate Puneet Bhasin is a Pioneer in Cyber Laws, Data Privacy & Protection and Online Entertainment laws in India and the most sought-after legal practitioner in this space. She is an advisor to the Rajya Sabha Committees on various aspects of Internet laws and is the recipient of 8 National Level Awards. She is a well-known author on Cyber laws and frequently contributes articles in newspapers and online portals. She regularly features on leading news channels including BBC, CNBC, Zee News, and DD News sharing her views and recommendations.

name: NS Nappinai
bio: N S Nappinai, Supreme Court Advocate and founder of Cyber Saathi™ (www.cybersaathi.org), is a senior and renowned lawyer (since 1991) focusing on litigation (Constitutional, Criminal, IPR & Cyber laws) and policy work, apart from her social responsibility engagements of contributing to India’s National Cyber Security Secretariat; Parliamentary Committees on Cyber laws and policies and for training judges, police, armed forces, students and industry. Alumna of IVLP (IPR), Chevening – Cyber Security and Stanford CDDRL Fellowships, Ms Nappinai is a prolific writer and author (Technology Laws Decoded (2017)), whose articles are published in leading National and International publications.

name: N Vijayaraghavan
bio: N Vijayaraghavan is a practising Advocate, Madras High Court, with over 3 decades of experience. He has authored several books like Constitution and its Making, Constitution and its Working & Supreme Court of India. He has been a resource person with TN Judicial Academy, run by the Madras High Court and National Judicial Academy, Bhopal, run by the Supreme Court of India.

name: Mool Chand Sharma
bio: Professor (Dr.) Moolchand Sharma is an established scholar who has worked extensively in the area of Constitutional jurisprudence; Law, Political Economics and development; Law, Politics and Democracy; Poverty and Human Rights jurisprudence.

name: Himanshu Tewari
bio: Himanshu Tewari is a respected professional with thirty years of assorted work experience. He is a Partner with KPMG in India and leads its Trade & Customs Services practice. He focuses on international trade transactions in the global value chain and its interplay with business metrices – market access, market share, revenue, cost optimization and margin governance. Himanshu is a graduate from Indian Institute of Technology, Kanpur. Himanshu is deeply engaged in discussion around India Trade Policy 2.0 - post 2023, and its impact on global businesses. As the Indian economy marches towards its US$ 10 trillion ambition, this book is a humble effort in picking a topic, which is an important building block of India’s Trade Policy 2.0. The author hopes that this book will be of help to global businesses interested in engaging with India’s economic growth story.

name: Dr Pawan Sharma
bio: Dr Pawan Sharma has been associated with the Law Commission of India for about three decades serving in various capacities including Secretary to the Commission, Joint Secretary and Law Officer (Indian Legal Service). Her contributions to the Commission's Reports such as child marriage, shared parentage, coparcenary property rights, compulsory marriage registration, right to education, and others dealing with women issues have been well appreciated and acknowledged. Apart from contributing to the Commission's agenda, her writings and articles published in various journals on issues relating to women and children have received wide acclaim. In 2017, she released her book, “Journey of the Women Law Reforms and the Law Commission of India: Some Insights”, which traced the history and journey of the Commission’s efforts towards reforming India’s legal system to be more inclusive for women.

name: Dr Khagesh Gautam
bio: Dr Khagesh Gautam is currently an associate professor of law at the Jindal Global Law School, O P Jindal Global University, where he teaches constitutional law, criminal procedure, and evidence, and has taught indirect taxation, forensic evidence, and interpretation of statutes. Dr Gautam has published several law-review articles and book chapters in India and internationally

name: Shruti Vidyasagar
bio: Shruti Vidyasagar is a lawyer practising in Bengaluru since 2005. She has pursued a varied legal practice over the years, advising on matters ranging from contract and employment law; to gender rights and prevention of workplace sexual harassment. Shruti is also an editor and works with several academics and publishers. She is currently Consulting Editor at DAKSH, and has co-edited many of DAKSH's flagship reports on the state of the Indian judiciary.

name: Dr Navjeet Sidhu Kundal
bio: Dr Navjeet Sidhu Kundal is an Assistant Professor at Vivekananda Institute of Professional Studies (VIPS), GGSIP University, Delhi. She is a Ph.D. in Commercial Law and has a rich academic experience. Her areas of interest include Public International Law, Corporate Law and Human Rights. Her research revolves around Human Rights, Businesses and CSR. She writes extensively on issues related to Corporate Governance, Corporate Social Responsibility, Business and Human Rights and Women in business. She has multiple books and research papers to her credit including International Humanitarian Law: A Reflection on 70 years of Geneva Conventions. She is currently working on a project sponsored by the National Human Rights Commission.

name: Dr Bharat Nain
bio: Dr. Bharat Nain is a corporate professional with 40+ years’ experience, including 26 years in Executive Search, HR consulting & Executive Coaching. He is the Founder-Director of United Resource Consultants Pvt Ltd and a POSH Advisor-Consultant- Trainer for organisations. Dr Nain is also a trained professional Arbitrator and has completed the Fellowship in International Arbitration from SIArb Singapore, as well as Membership from CIArb, London. He is the co-author of 'FAQs on Arbitration in India', a comprehensive book on the subject of Arbitration.

name: Nomesh Bhojkumar Bolia
bio: Dr Nomesh Bolia is a professor at IIT Delhi and the founding Director of its Public Systems Lab. His research and innovation interests are in Operations Research and its applications to Public Systems, Public Policy and Governance. Prof Bolia is the recipient of several nation- al-international awards and grants such as the Indo-US Science and Technology Forum's Public Health Fellowship, DAAD (German) Research Stays, Volvo Research & Educational Foundations (VREF) Study Visitation and Teaching Excellence Award at IIT Delhi. He has published several papers in international journals of repute, consulted many companies in the public/private sector in India and mentored start-ups in the broad domain of Operations Research. He is also the founding coordinator of the DAKSH Centre of Excellence for Law & Technology. His vision and commitment to the area of Industrial Engineering and Operations Research have been recognised by the Government of India that nominated him as a member of the Board of Governors of the National Institute of Industrial Engineering (later IIM Mumbai), India's premier institute in this area, and for other responsibilities such as member of the Academic Advisory Committee of the National Assessment and Accreditation Council of India, Visitor's Nominee to various IITs and on several other committees.

name: Dr Aditya Nain
bio: Dr Aditya Nain is an investment consultant, author and professor with expertise in two domains: investments and philosophy. He is the co-author of Understanding Money, a book on the philosophy of money, published by Routledge. Aditya holds a Ph.D. from IIT Bombay, and is visiting faculty at liberal arts schools. He has developed and taught courses in philosophy and logic at universities for over ten years and has delivered talks on philosophy, intellectual history, investments, Bitcoin and cryptocurrencies. He is currently working on a book on Bitcoin and political philosophy.

name: Surya Prakash BS
bio: Surya Prakash BS is Programme Director at DAKSH a civil society organisation working on transforming India's law and justice system. He has been working closely with courts, tribunals, governments, researchers, and academic institutions over the last 7 years in this field. He has pub- lished, and guided teams in carrying out original research that has contributed to understanding ground realities and envisioned systemic changes. His areas of interest are empirical legal research, complex social systems, technology, and analytics. He is a chartered accountant and law graduate who has worked in the corporate sector prior to this role.

name: Sandhya P.R.
bio: Sandhya P.R. is a graduate of ILS Law College and University College London. She is currently a Senior Research Fellow at DAKSH. Prior to this, she was a practising lawyer. She takes a keen interest in various areas of research, such as application of judicial data in understanding litigation, improving access to justice, and exploring the use of technology to improve justice delivery.

name: Adarsh Ramanujan
bio: Adarsh Ramanujan is a patent agent and an independent litigation attorney with a broad counsel practice, having represented clients across sectors ranging from pharmaceuticals and biotech to textiles and telecom. Throughout his career, Adarsh has consistently engaged with cutting-edge legal issues, particularly in IP law. He has argued and assisted in significant cases before the Supreme Court of India, multiple High Courts, and specialised tribunals. His career is distinguished by his extensive experience in international disputes, which is bolstered by a three-year tenure in Geneva, Switzerland. His notable contributions to patent law and IP jurisprudence in India have made him a sought-after litigator in these domains.

name: Gauri Grover
bio: Gauri Grover is a dedicated legal professional practising in the Delhi High Court, specializing in civil, criminal, and humanitarian cases. Her work reflects her commitment to justice, with a focus on addressing pressing societal issues. Beyond her legal pursuits, Gauri is a passionate golfer, finding joy and discipline in the sport. She is deeply involved in theatre, showcasing her creative flair, and designs exquisite costume jewellery, blending artistry with craftsmanship. A fervent activist, she tirelessly champions justice-oriented principles, advocating for fairness and equity. Gauri’s multifaceted personality combines her legal acumen with artistic pursuits and an unyielding dedication to social change.

name: Sharath Chandran
bio: Mr Sharath Chandran is an Advocate practising primarily at the Madras High Court. He completed his law from the ILS Law College, Pune and went on to read for the B.C.L from the University of Oxford. He has co-authored several books on the Constitution of India, Motor Vehicles Laws, Principles of Insurance Law, Law of Evidence et al.

name: Karan Trehan
bio: Karan Trehan is an advocate at a top-tier law firm in India, specialising in the areas of electricity law, arbitration, & white-collar crimes. Having represented organisations across a range of sectors, he is known for effectively handling complex and high-stakes litigations. Karan has a passion for legal research and writing, having authored a book and contributed to various legal publications, which demonstrate his versatility and depth of knowledge.

name: Shruti Bedi
bio: Prof. Dr. Shruti Bedi is Professor and Director at the University Institute of Legal Studies (UILS), Panjab University (PU), India; International Fellow at the National Institute of Military Justice, Washington DC, USA; Visiting Professor at the Faculty of Law, Universitas Airlangga, Surabaya, Indonesia; Member, Executive Council, India International University of Legal Education and Research (IIULER), Goa; Director, Centre for Constitution and Public Policy, UILS, PU; and a TEDx speaker. Her areas of research include constitutional law, counter-terrorism law, and comparative public law.

name: Dhana Madhri Guruswamy
bio: Dhana Madhri Guruswamy is an experienced advocate with a diverse legal background. She is a recognized expert on the POSH Act and has led initiatives aimed at creating safer workplaces across various sectors. Madhri's practical experience includes serving as an External Member on Internal Committees for numerous private, public, and multinational organizations, where she has played a crucial role in handling complex inquiries related to the POSH Act. As a sought-after trainer, she has conducted many specialized sessions for Internal Committee members and employees, offering comprehensive guidance on compliance, inquiry processes, and best practices associated with the POSH Act.

name: Dr K K Khandelwal, IAS (R)
bio: Dr K K Khandelwal, IAS (R), LLB, LLM, PhD (Law), is engineer, legal expert, author, and academician. He currently serves as the Chief National Commissioner of the Bharat Scouts and Guides in New Delhi. Prior to this, he held the position of Chairman of the Haryana Real Estate Regulatory Authority in Gurugram. Dr K K Khandelwal's contributions span across his roles in civil service, academia, and legal literature. His work, particularly in the field of real estate regulation and scout leadership, alongside his academic contributions, has been widely recognized. His interdisciplinary research and publications reflect his broad range of academic pursuits and professional engagements.

name: Md. Tauseef Alam
bio: Md. Tauseef Alam is a law student at the Lloyd School of Law. Currently, he assists Shri Sujeet Kumar as his Legislative and Public Policy Associate, and Trainee Associate at LexMantra. Previously he has contributed by assisting Sr. Adv. Salman Khurshid, in prominent constitutional matters of AMU Minority Status and SC/ST Reservation. He has also assisted the Hon’ble Chief Justice, Calcutta High Court; Delhi Commission for Child Rights; Sr. Adv. SV Raju, Additional Solicitor General for India et al.

name: Dr Farah Shoaib
bio: Dr Farah Shoaib is an Assistant Professor of Psychology at Integral University. With a strong passion for teaching, she has a proven track record of excellence, having previously prepared students for the NET/JRF Psychology examinations. Many of her students successfully qualified for both NET and JRF on their first attempt, and are now pursuing their PhDs at prestigious institutions like IITs and Central Universities. Dr Farah actively provides free learning resources and updates through her Telegram channel, "NET/JRF Psychology by Dr Farah," and her YouTube channel, "GyaniIndians." These platforms extend her educational reach, allowing her to support a broader audience of psychology students and enthusiasts.

name: Yashi Dhariwal
bio: Yashi Dhariwal has worked in the Political and Media department of the Chinese Consulate in Kolkata. She holds a BA in Political Science from Presidency College and MA in International Relations from Jadavpur University. Yashi has been guiding the aspirants of civil services and state services examinations. She is extremely passionate about international politics and foreign affairs.

name: Sagar Srivastava
bio: Sagar Srivastava is a Range Forest Officer with the Madhya Pradesh Government. Previously he has worked as Assistant System Engineer with Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) after completing his Bachelor of Engineering in Electronics and Communication. He has also been mentoring state services aspirants at various coaching institutes.

name: Prithivi Raj
bio: Prithivi Raj is a lawyer turned academician, currently serving as an Assistant Professor at Birla Global University, Odisha. He is a multifaceted professional with over seven years of experience in litigation at various Indian courts and tribunals. He was also an elected member of the High Court Bar Association in Odisha. Furthermore, he holds editorial leadership positions for the Indian Journal of Law, Polity and Administration and has prior affiliations with NMIMS and ICFAI University.

name: Dheera Khandelwal
bio: Dheera Khandelwal is a distinguished retired officer of the Indian Administrative Service (IAS), belonging to the Haryana cadre (1986 batch) and is at present holding the position of Member, Police Complaints Authority, Chandigarh. She has held several key positions, including Additional Chief Secretary of Environment & Climate Change, School Education, and Women & Child Development; and Chairperson and Appellate Authority of the Haryana State Pollution Control Board, dealing extensively with environmental legislation and related judicial matters. An accomplished academic, Dheera holds a Master’s degree from Kanpur University and an LLB from Panjab University. She is also an acclaimed author, recognised for her literary contributions in Hindi poetry and significant works related to law. Her literary accolades include the Best Woman Writer Award from Haryana Sahitya Akademi and the Best Book Award from Chandigarh Sahitya Akademi in 2018.

name: Ankit Malhotra
bio: Ankit Malhotra read his B.A. and LL.B from O.P. Jindal Global University. He was awarded, from 2017-2022, Best Student Researcher, Rank 1 for Outstanding Contribution to Academic Initiatives, Outstanding All-Round Performance and a Gold Medal in Recognition of Outstanding Performance and Certificate for Outstanding Leadership. In 2022-2023, as the Felix Scholar, he read his LLM in International Law at the School of Oriental and African Studies, University of London. Mr. Malhotra has worked in the Chambers of Justice A.K. Sikri and since then has assisted in rendering expert reports and assistance in cases to domestic and foreign courts on recognition of foreign orders, international abduction, and the nuances of Private and Public International Family Law issues from an Indian perspective.

name: Dr B S Patil
bio: Dr. B.S. Patil is an Associate Professor at V.M. Salgaocar College of Law, Goa, where he has taught for over two decades. A legal educator and academic coach, his work spans Courtroom Ethics, Disability Rights, Alternative Dispute Resolution, and Criminal Law. He holds a Ph.D. in Human Rights of Disabled Persons. His passion for justice has led him to design modules on client counselling, negotiation, and conflict management, and to serve as a national consultant on elder rights and adoption law. He has published extensively, trained educators nationwide, and contributed to national initiatives including UGC e-Pathshala and CARA.

name: Sujeet Kumar
bio: Sujeet Kumar is a Member of Parliament (MP) in the Rajya Sabha, representing the state of Odisha. He was one of the youngest MPs to head the Petitions Committee of Rajya Sabha. An Engineer turned Lawyer, he is currently practising law at the Supreme Court of India, various High Courts and Tribunals. He is the founder and Managing Partner of LexMantra. Previously, he worked at the World Economic Forum (WEF) in Geneva, Switzerland, and for United Nations Development Program (UNDP) and for Infosys Technologies Ltd. in India.

name: Prabhdeep Kaur Malhotra
bio: Dr Prabhdeep Kaur Malhotra is an academician currently working as an Assistant Professor at Amity Law School, Amity University, Noida, India. She has experience of working as an Associate Researcher in the government administration industry and public policy departments. She has previously worked in the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Ministry of Law and Justice, and as a Public Policy Professional in the IPR Department of various Associations of India.

name: Arvind P Bhanu
bio: Prof (Dr) Arvind P Bhanu has been working in the field of law for more than three decades and has held several positions at various institutes, ascending from Assistant Professor to Principal and Head. Currently, Dr Bhanu is working as Professor of Law and Research, and Additional Director/Joint Head, ALSN, Amity University, Noida.

name: Alok S Jha
bio: Alok S Jha is the founding director of The Accord Administrative Institute (AAI). He graduated from Delhi University in History. He has also pursued LLB from Delhi University. He has been guiding students in subjects like History and Art & Culture for civil services and state services examinations for the last 16 years. He is an established author and his book A Brief History of the Modern World and its Hindi version Vishwa ka Itihaas is popular among the students. During his academic career, he has successfully helped many students in cracking Civil Services Examination.

bio: Chitra Narayan Bhumesh Verma Anindita Pattanayak Daksh Akanksha Bisen Anghrija Chakraborty Ashima Obhan Asheeta Regidi M Sricharan Rangarajan Viral Mehta V Sudhish Pai Sumit Pahwa Sudhir Kumar Katriar Sriram Panchu Somesh Arora Shailashri Bhaskar Saurabh Bindal Sagar Tilak SS Naganand Richa Kachhwaha Udayan Mukerji R K Naroola Puneet Bhasin Jonathan Rodrigues Nisshant Laroia N Vijayaraghavan NS Nappinai Mool Chand Sharma Nilendra Kumar K Kannan Himanshu Tewari Dr Pawan Sharma Dr Navjeet Sidhu Kundal Dr Khagesh Gautam Dr. Justice Shalini P Joshi Dr Aditya Nain Dr Bharat Nain Ranjit Malhotra Anil Malhotra Amar K Sundram Sandhya P.R. name: Pradeep Singh
bio: Pradeep Singh has secured AIR 93 in UPSC Civil Services Examination 2018 in his first attempt at the young age of 22. He graduated with Hons. in Commerce from International Institute of Professional Studies - DAVV, Indore. He has keen interest in the Political system and Governance related matters of India. He is an eloquent orator as well as a poet.

name: Rahul Garg, ICAS
bio: Rahul Garg is an officer of Indian Civil Accounts Service (ICAS) and currently serving as Deputy Controller of Accounts in IT Division of PFMS. Formerly, he was also associated with Indian Railways after securing Rank 10 in UPSC IES Examination. Known for his thoughtfulness and analytical approach, he was awarded with ‘Best Debater’ award in NIFM Officer’s batch of 2017. He loves guiding the aspirants of Civil Services examination on the ethics and the various disciplines related to it.

name: Venkata Mohan
bio: Venkata Mohan is a B. Tech from IIT Madras. He is the author of multiple books on the subjects like sociology and ethics. He has also penned down other books for general readers. He has been guiding the aspirants of Civil Services for several years. Under his guidance, many students have successfully cracked the Civil Services examination.

name: Gazal Bharadwaj
bio: Gazal Bharadwaj is an IAS officer of Uttar Pradesh Cadre. She is currently serving as the Chief Development Officer of Rampur. A civil engineer from GBPUAT, she did her master’s in public administration and management from JNU. A history enthusiast, a poet, and photographer she wishes to explore the concerns of modern administration with a better understanding of history.

name: Dhanashree Patil
bio: Dhanashree Patil is an officer of the Indian Civil Accounts Service, currently posted in New Delhi. She holds a bachelor's degree in International Relations from Mount Holyoke College, USA, and is a former fellow of the Young India Fellowship of Ashoka University. She has been guiding aspirants of the Civil Services Examination through Essay Enrichment Program. An ardent reader of complex texts, she is known for making complex writing simple and accessible to the readers.

name: Naveen Kumar Chandra
bio: Naveen Kumar Chandra is an avid reader and prolific writer. He is also very interested in subjects and topics such as economics, philosophy, psychology, physics, astronomy, music and art. He also loves to paint and sketch. He writes on a variety of issues and topics and has published several books. He has a blog which he has been writing for over 10 years. Having graduated from IIT Roorkee, he is currently working as an IAS officer in the state of West Bengal.

name: Dr Zubairul Islam
bio: Dr Zubairul Islam is an Associate Professor of Geography at ADU, Africa. He has been a facilitator for a series of training programs on ‘Application of GIS and Remote Sensing, sponsored by the federal government of Ethiopia, Addis Ababa. In these programs, he has addressed officers of the land administration department, Municipal department, and the use of GIS techniques for Geodatabase development and management.

name: Smarak Swain
bio: Smarak Swain graduated in Electrical Engineering from the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Kharagpur in 2006 and has joined the Indian Revenue Service (IRS) in 2008. In the Income Tax department, he has wide experience in the fields of corporate and business assessments, financial investigation, tax administration of charitable and religious trusts, and international taxation.

name: Lohit Matani
bio: Lohit Matani is an Indian Police Service (IPS) officer of the 2014 batch posted in Maharashtra cadre. He holds B Tech and M Tech degrees in Material Science and Technology from the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Banaras Hindu University (BHU), Varanasi. Lohit loves interacting with young students and candidates preparing.

name: Manuj Jindal
bio: Manuj Jindal is an officer of the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) of the 2017 batch. At present he is serving as an Officer Trainee in the Maharashtra cadre and is posted as Assistant Collector of Wardha. He is actively associated with guiding Civil Services aspirants.

name: Nitesh Dhawan
bio: Dr Nitesh Dhawan is working as State Director, KVIC (Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Government of India). He was also Ex- Visiting Faculty of the Department of Social Work at University of Lucknow, UP. He loves interacting with the young students and candidates preparing for the civil services examination through his articles, blogs, and books.

name: Atul Kulkarni
bio: Atul Kulkarni is serving as an Indian Police Service (IPS) officer in Maharashtra cadre. He secured AIR (All India Rank) 180 in CSE, 2014. He has also obtained a post-graduation degree from Tata Institute of Social Sciences in the area of Urban policy and Governance. Known for changing the face of women-safety through ‘Bharosa’ cells, he is popular for his people-friendly ways of policing.

name: R Rajagopalan
bio: R Rajagopalan, a former Professor at IIT Madras, has been a facilitator in a large number of programmes entitled Ethics in Public Governance for officers of the IAS and other central services as well as those from state governments and public sector units. These programmes are organized by Initiatives of Change (IC), Panchgani, and the IC Centre for Governance, Delhi. Professor Rajagopalan is also the author of the very popular books Environment and Ecology: A Complete Guide and Case Studies in Ethics Integrity and Aptitude for the Civil Services Examination.

name: Mohan Krishnamurthy
bio: Mohan, aka nomad man, is a geophysicist on paper, with a heart full of wander lust. He has been a travel geek since his school days. Till date, he is known to have carried out expeditions to destinations off the beaten path; he is a man full of stories. He is a path finder and hates being confined to an office. With truckloads of the ‘never-give-up’ spirit, whenever grounded, he loves to teach, inspire students, guide university graduates across the world and civil service aspirants in India; he has been instrumental in creating numerous civil servants in India in the past decade. In his free time, you can find him reading on the beach, hiking up a mountain or exploring uninhabited places.

name: Mrityunjay Rai
bio: Mrityunjay Rai is a distinguished mentor for the UPSC aspirants and is associated with several reputed institutions. With an extensive teaching experience spanning over a decade, he is popularly known amongst the aspirants as ‘Bahubali Sir’. This book is a consolidation of his insights on the subject for the benefit of the civil services examination aspirants.

name: Sudhanshu Mishra
bio: Sudhanshu Mishra, the author of this UPPSC exam preparation book, holds a B.A., LL.B. and an MBA. As the founder of IAS NEXT, he is characterised by more than 5,000 enrolled students, a dedicated team of more than 20 qualified teachers, more than 5 national awards and rich experience of more than 15 years.

name: Deb Tripathi
bio: Deb Tripathi is an innovative technology leader with over 24-years of expertise in Technology Architecture, Digital Transformation, Software Engineering, and Automation. He has led complex digital transformations for Fortune 500 companies globally and holds two US patents in integration and automation. He holds exceptional leadership experience and has been associated with Accenture as the Managing Director. He co-founded Edukemy to improve education quality and provide meaningful learning experiences to students across India.

name: Ramakrishnan Viraraghavan
bio: Ramakrishnan Viraraghavan is a Barrister and Senior Advocate based in New Delhi, practising at the Supreme Court of India. He is a tenant in Chambers at 33 Bedford Row and has rights of audience before the Royal Courts of Justice in England and Wales. He carries nearly four decades of experience in taxation and commercial litigation. He has appeared before almost every tier of taxation authorities from the Commissioner to the Supreme Court of India, at various stages of his career.

name: A P Bhardwaj
bio: A. P. BHARDWAJ is a well-known name, and an established author of #1 best- selling books on English and essay papers for IAS MAINS and states’ civil and judicial services examinations. He has single- handedly trained and tutored innumerable students to get admission into national law universities and colleges. He has also trained and enabled hundreds of students to score well in English and essay papers in civil and judicial services examinations. He has authored more than ten books

name: Nirbhay Sharma
bio: Nirbhay Sharma is an established advocate of the Supreme Court. After pursuing LLB from Campus Law Centre, university of Delhi, he completed his Master in Business Laws from NLSIU, Bangalore and LLN from Kurukshetra University. He underwent a General Course in Intellectual Property conducted by the World Intellectual Property Organisation, Geneva. He has been passionately guiding aspirants on Civil Services as well as Judicial Services examinations from the past 15 years. He also teaches Constitutional Law as guest faculty in law colleges in different parts of India.

name: Pooja Prasanna
bio: With tailored teaching experience for UPSC Exam, Pooja Prasanna understands the unique challenges students face in this competitive exam. Through engaging classroom methods and student-centered approaches, she simplifies intricate sociological theories using clear explanations, real-world examples, and case studies. Holding a Master's degree in Sociology, she provides profound insights into key sociological concepts of the UPSC syllabus.

name: K R Sekar
bio: K R Sekar is a Partner with Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP and Leader – Domestic Market and Deloitte Private for Deloitte India. He has over three decades of experience in the fields of international taxation, transfer pricing, direct taxes and mergers and acquisitions. He is also associated with several landmark litigations relating to global companies. He was recognised as one of India's leading tax advisers in Legal Media Group's Guide to the World's Leading Tax Advisers, Euromoney and International Tax Review. He has served as the President of the Bangalore Chamber of Industry & Commerce and is the Governing Member of the International Tax Research and Analysis Foundation (ITRAF), a dedicated research body in the field of international tax.

name: Vaibhav Kumar
bio: वैभव कुमार, वर्तमान में सिविल सेवा प्रशिक्षक एवं मार्गदर्शक के रूप में विभिन्न अभ्यर्थियों का मार्गदर्शन एवं निर्देशन कर रहे हैं। इन्होने आईएएस एवं विभिन्न पीएससी परीक्षाओं में प्री एवं मेन्स की परीक्षायें उत्तीर्ण की हैं तथा हिंदी साहित्य, राजनीति विज्ञान एवं समाज कार्य जैसे विषयों का गहन अध्ययन किया है तथा स्नातकोत्तर उपाध्यिाँ प्राप्त की हैं।

name: Sudhanshu Kumar
bio: Sudhanshu Kumar is associated with several premier Civil Services coaching institutes in Delhi, Bhubaneshwar, Bengaluru, and Patna. He holds Graduate and Post Graduate degrees in Computer Science from Delhi. He has been guiding aspirants of Civil Services examination for over a decade.

name: Parthasarathi Shome
bio: Parthasarathi Shome is currently Chairman, ITRAF, Bengaluru, and Visiting Senior Fellow, London School of Economics. He was Adviser (Minister of State) to the Indian Finance Minister, and chaired India’s Tax Administration Reform Commission (TARC). He has held various positions, including Chief Economist, UK Revenue and Customs; Chief of Tax Policy, IMF; and Professor, American University, Washington DC. His work on GAAR and retrospective taxation is widely cited. He is a recipient of Brazil’s highest civilian honour, Commander of the Order of the Southern Cross, for his contributions to Brazilian fiscal reform. He is widely published in international peer reviewed journals and books and is invited to speak across the globe.

name: Kamna Singh
bio: कामना सिंह, वर्तमान में राज्य कर अध्किारी, उत्तर प्रदेश के पद पर नियुक्त हैं। इनका चयन उत्तर प्रदेश लोक सेवा आयोग द्वारा आयोजित पीएससी परीक्षा 2016 में हुआ। लेखिका को आईएएस एवं विभिन्न राज्यों की पीएससी परीक्षायें देने का अनुभव रहा है। इसके पूर्व इन्हें 10 वर्षों का विभिन्न सरकारी एवं प्राइवेट सिविल सर्विस कोचिंग संस्थानों में अभ्यर्थियों को सिविल सेवा के लिए मार्गदर्शन देने का अनुभव रहा है तथा इनके निर्देशन में अनेक अभ्यर्थियों ने आईएएस एवं पीएससी जैसी परीक्षाओं में उच्च स्थान प्राप्त किया है।

name: Atul Kumar Gupta
bio: Atul Kumar Gupta is a fellow member of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India and the Institute of Cost Accountants of India, besides being a Law Graduate. A member of various other professional bodies and Institutions, Mr Gupta is a thorough scholar and has qualified CA examination with All India Rank. He was a Central Council Member of ICAI from 2013-16 & 2016-2019

name: Harpreet Kaur
bio: Harpreet Kaur, former faculty at Guru Nanak Dev University, Amritsar and founding director of Egzaminer is a seasoned writer and has dedicated herself to simplifying the complexities of competitive exams, primarily NTA UGC-NET Paper 1. With a wealth of knowledge and a knack for clarity, she has perfectly mastered the art of guiding the aspiring individuals through the intricate maze of competitive exams. Through this book, get ready to embark on a transformative journey as she shares insights, strategies, and a roadmap to success in the world of competitive exams.

name: CA Pushpendra Dixit
bio: CA Pushpendra Dixit is a taxation professional having diverse experience of over 18 years in Direct and Indirect taxation. His expertise spans a wide range of tax-related areas, including SEZ/Developer Units establishment, GST implementation, and international tax dispute resolution. His international experience includes successful representations before German tax authorities and initiatives to optimize tax efficiencies across multiple jurisdictions. He is also a visiting faculty at ICAI and NLU Delhi.

name: Pratap Singh
bio: Pratap Singh is an IRS officer with elaborate experience in tax policy formulation and administration over the last 32 years. During his career, he has assumed significant roles in the Government of India and has served at different locations including Delhi, Bangalore, Mumbai, and Gurgaon. He is also the author of the book Reforms in Tax Administration: An Indian Experience, and has written research papers. In addition to this, he has chaired committees and has authored several reports. Mr Singh's expertise has resulted in several amendments in the Income Tax laws. A regular columnist for Taxindiaonline and other magazines & newspapers, Mr Singh is also a sought after speaker on taxation and administrative issues. He has a website www.pratapsinghirs.com, where he shares his views and experiences. He has been a huge votary of sustainability and environmental protection and has carried out mega plantation drives in Gurgaon, Faridabad, Hisar and Aligarh. He supports various social causes like education and community development through his NGO, Ujjawalika Foundation. Mr Singh holds an MTech from IIT Kanpur and a PhD in Developmental Studies from Mysore University, besides holding degrees in Law and Management. This second book follows after a very successful first book where he continues to showcase his prowess.

name: CS Nikunj Gupta
bio: CS Nikunj Gupta is an experienced professional with diverse academic credentials, including a Company Secretary qualification, LL.B., and an M.A. in Economics. He boasts achievements in UPPSC exams and has received the President and Governor Awards, showcasing his dedication to excellence.

name: Chetan Dalal
bio: Chetan D Dalal, a Chartered Accountant and a Certified Fraud Examiner, conducts fraud investigations and training in detection of fraud. He is also a Certified Internal Auditor and a Certified Information Systems Auditor. He has served on the Board of the Association of Certified Fraud Examiners (India Chapter) and India Merchants Chamber. He has also served in the past on the editorial board of an international journal - "Inside Fraud Bulletin". He has been the chief faculty member in the first ever certification course on forensic accounting and fraud investigation for the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India. He has authored several publications on fraud detection, internal audits, audit practices and procedures which have been published by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India and the Bombay Chartered Accountants Society.

name: Shabbir A Bashir
bio: Shabbir A Bashir, a renowned UPSC preparation trainer with over 21 years of experience, has a deep understanding of geography and environment. He co-founded Edukemy to make teaching and learning more engaging and effective, aiming to democratize education and reach all, regardless of location or socioeconomic status. Bashir holds a Civil Engineering degree and is certified in management and leadership skills by INSEAD (ILPSE).

name: G Natarajan
bio: Ganesh Natarajan is an advocate by profession. He is also an Associate Member of the ICMA (ICWA). Prior to joining the legal profession, he has served as an Inspector of Central Excise in the Customs and Central Excise department from 1993 to 2003. His area of specialization is indirect taxation. Mr Natarajan is a well-known writer in the field of indirect taxation and has to his credit over 500 incisive articles published in leading magazines, journals, and tax portals.

name: Ganesh Rajgopalan
bio: Ganesh Rajgopalan is a seasoned Chartered Accountant with 36 years of experience. He is an expert in the areas of taxation and manages tax audits and litigation on income-tax and indirect tax matters. His academic research interests presently are in the areas of taxation, copyright law, and international trade laws. He is a proficient author with several published research papers in leading journals and conferences of national and international repute. Mr Ganesh is an active participant and contributor to the knowledge-building initiatives of leading professional bodies and research institutions including the Bombay Chartered Accountants’ Society and the Chamber of Tax Consultants. He was awarded the Heather Self Medal by Chartered Institute of Taxation, United Kingdom (CIOT) in 2013.

name: K Vaitheeswaran
bio: K Vaitheeswaran has 30 years of experience in dispute advisory and litigation, consulting clients across the country in all practice areas. He is considered a specialist in tax and legal matters. He is a prolific writer and has authored various books on taxation and has contributed to innumerable articles, both in print and digital media.

name: Rav Pratap Singh
bio: Rav Pratap Singh is an Assistant Professor of Legal Practice at OP Jindal Global University, Sonipat. He also acts as a legal consultant to various entities especially startups, e-commerce companies, and fintech firms. He primarily provides advisory services and legal opinions relating to GST, digital taxation, tax policy, and matters relating to property law.

name: Kinshuk Jha
bio: Kinshuk Jha is an Associate Professor and Executive Director, Centre for Comparative and International Taxation (CCIT), Jindal Global Law School (JGLS). He has been teaching domestic and international taxation and his been involved in several academic projects, ranging from innovations at the level of higher secondary education in India, where he co-authored the Legal Studies textbook for CBSE, to being part of an expert panel at the recent USTR investigations of India’s Digital Services Tax. His work focuses on taxpayer rights, anti-abuse provisions and digital taxation.

name: Mukesh Bhutani
bio: Mukesh Butani is Founder & Managing Partner of BMR Legal Advocates. With specialisation in domestic corporate international tax and transfer pricing, he has over three decades of experience in advising multinationals and Indian conglomerates on a wide range of matters relating to FDI policy, business re-organisations, cross-border tax structuring, tax controversy and regulatory policy. He is an acknowledged expert in the area of International Tax policy, controversy & advocacy, and has to his credit several landmark judicial pronouncements.

name: Karthik Sundaram
bio: Karthik Sundaram is an independent advocate, practicing in the Madras High Court, with over a decade of experience in the field of taxation. He is the founder counsel of Karthik Law Chambers and extensively focuses on Indirect tax litigation and Commercial litigation including Customs, GST, erstwhile Service Tax, VAT, Excise, Trade Policy, Anti-dumping related measures and Arbitration. He has and continues to be involved in various high-stake tax disputes at the Supreme Court, High Court, and Tribunal level for various Fortune 500 companies, large multinational companies, and Indian businesses. He also regularly advises a wide spectrum of companies on a variety of tax related issues including GST. Karthik has a significant number of articles on taxation to his credit and is a regular speaker at various conferences/seminars across India on the topic of taxation.

name: Krupa Venkatesh
bio: Krupa Venkatesh is an indirect tax professional with nearly 33 years of experience. She is a Cost Accountant and Company Secretary by qualification and has wide ranging experience in various aspects of indirect taxes.She started her career with the Government of India and then worked with Deloitte India for 14 years, where she was a Partner in charge on the Bangalore and Chennai Indirect tax practices. She was instrumental in setting up the Bangalore, Chennai Indirect Tax practice and has advised several Indian and multinational clients in manufacturing, banking, insurance, retail, e-commerce, and other service sectors. She spent 3 years with Amazon India as Director for India taxes where she spearheaded the implementation of GST for all of Amazon India entities. Currently, she mentors Consark Advisory Services LLP, a boutique advisory services firm.She started her career with the Government of India and then worked with Deloitte India for 14 years, where she was a Partner in charge on the Bangalore and Chennai Indirect tax practices. She was instrumental in setting up the Bangalore, Chennai Indirect Tax practice and has advised several Indian and multinational clients in manufacturing, banking, insurance, retail, e-commerce, and other service sectors.

name: P V Srinivasan
bio: P V Srinivasan is a Chartered Accountant by qualification and a Member of ICAI. He is engaged as a corporate advisor, advising leading business houses on global taxation and corporate law matters. He has over 33 years of hands-on experience in manufacturing and information technology industries with regard to corporate tax compliances across tax jurisdictions including the US, Europe, India and Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa. He headed the Corporate Tax function at Wipro, Bangalore for over 18 years.

name: Nirmalkumar Mohandoss
bio: Nirmalkumar Mohandoss is an advocate based in Chennai practising before the High Court of Judicature at Madras. He has authored articles and opinion pieces in numerous leading journals, magazines and dailies. He has also co-authored a chapter in the book titled, 'The Right To Sanitation In India', published by the Oxford University Press. He represents the Government of Puducherry, ESI Corporation and several other Public Sector Undertakings before the High Court of Judicature at Madras. In consonance with the views shared in the book, he has been relentlessly working towards having a High Court established for Puducherry. Beyond professional practice, the author engages in legal and constitutional discourse as a public intellectual in print, social and other media platforms, seeking to bridge the divide between legal understanding and public consciousness.

name: Jatinder Singh
bio: Jatinder Singh is a personal optimisation advisor, author, and proponent of new-age business strategies. With his unwavering commitment to sustainability, Jatinder empowers entrepreneurs and corporations to achieve impactful and lasting growth aligned with sustainable development goals. His guiding philosophy—the opposite of poverty is not wealth, but sustainable development - underscores his mission to embed sustainability at the core of societal and organisational progress. With a Law Degree, a Management Degree, and a Ph.D. in Business Management, Jatinder combines deep knowledge with practical insights to drive meaningful change in today's business world.

name: Mohit Khullar
bio: Mohit Khullar is a dynamic leader with over 23 years of experience in senior management roles spanning Risk and Quality, Consulting, and Strategy. An EMCC-accredited coach and thought leader, Mohit is passionate about transforming leadership paradigms to meet the demands of an ever-evolving world. His celebrated ‘Boss vs Coach’ series on LinkedIn has become a cornerstone for driving meaningful conversations around leadership evolution, inspiring professionals globally to adopt coaching-style leadership. Beyond his corporate endeavors, Mohit is an accomplished writer and poet.

name: Garvika Mittal
bio: Garvika Mittal Garvika Mittal is a 13 year old girl, studying in Delhi Public School, Mathura Road. She has a creative mind and a flair for writing stories of her own. She intends to bring her creativity to all through a series of storybooks.

name: Sanjay Kumar
bio: Sanjay Kumar is a tax partner with Deloitte India. He is also the public policy leader for Deloitte India and Deloitte Asia- Pacific. Sanjay was earlier with the Indian Revenue Service for more than 28 years. He teaches at Duke University, USA since 2007.

name: K J Alphons
bio: K. J. Alphons, from 1979 batch of the Indian Administrative Service, quit and joined politics in 2006. He is currently a Member of the Indian Parliament. During his tenure as Tourism Minister of India, from 2017 to 2019, India rose to the 3rd rank in global tourism, as per Global Travel and Tourism Council. He was also Minister of State for Electronics and Information Technology. He rose to national prominence as an effective administrator and anti-corruption crusader. As the Commissioner of the Delhi Development Authority, he demolished 14,310 illegal buildings. These actions earned him the title, ‘The Demolition Man’. He pioneered the literacy movement in India by making Kottayam India’s 1st 100% literate town. The mass contact program he started as District Collector won the highest UN award for innovation in governance. He was in the list of 100 Young Global Leaders of TIME Magazine, along with Bill Gates, Steve Jobs, etc.

name: TG Suresh
bio: T G Suresh, Senior Partner of Suresh & Balaji, Chartered Accountants, has over 34 years of experience in direct tax, international tax, and foreign exchange laws. He is a faculty member at Maruti Coaching in Chennai and a visiting faculty member at professional organizations like ICAI, ICSI, and ICMAI. Suresh is also the Chairman of the International Fiscal Association – Southern Regional Chapter and the Direct Tax Task Force of the South Indian Chamber of Commerce and Industry.

name: Raju Z Moray
bio: An alumnus of St. Xaviers College and Government Law College, Bombay Mr. Moray is a practicing lawyer. He was enrolled as an advocate in 1985 and joined the Chambers of Advocate Michael F. Saldanha (Later judge of Bombay & Karnataka High Courts). For the past 35 years Mr. Moray has been contributing articles and poems to the various publications of the Lawyers Collective. An anthology of his ‘Court Jester’ columns for the Lawyer’s Collective magazine was published as a book ‘COURT JESTER’ to critical acclaim in 2017 and a series of 60 poems penned during the lockdown was published as ‘THE LOCKED DOWN LAWYER’ in December 2021. His highly popular ‘Adaalat Antics’ stories appear regularly on theleaflet.in web portal.

name: Shailendra Kumar
bio: Shailendra Kumar is the Founder Editor of India’s First PIB recognised Online Press-www.taxindiaonline.com popularly known as TIOL. He is recognized for his distinguished services of about 21 long years in the field of online journalism besides the 10 years of service in the Print Media (Newspapers). Through his highly popular and respected Weekly Column ‘The Cob(Web)’ he has been sharing innovative and inventive ideas with the policy makers who have been generous enough to acknowledge his efforts on a regular basis. He has previously published a book on black money titled It’s Raining Black.

name: Subhash Jangala
bio: Subhash Jangala is an officer of the Indian Revenue Service. He has extensive experience in tax administration including investigation, tax policy, international negotiations, media, communication and taxpayer outreach. He has represented India at multiple international fora. He contributes occasionally to English dailies.

name: SP Singh
bio: S P Singh (SP) is presently Senior Advisor to the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI). He has worked with the Indian Revenue Service where he served for over two decades in various capacities. He then joined Deloitte India as Senior Director where he led several initiatives.

name: Olivia Gadd
bio: Olivia Gadd is the co-founder of Big Thinking Space, an exciting global venture to bring coaching and coaching skills to a wider audience. As master coach and seasoned trainer she has worked with boards, owners and leaders to help them define success for themselves and their organisations. Her drive and purpose is to help people find self-determination by working on beliefs, thinking and behaviours to find energy and joy. Her clients range from sole traders to corporate CEOs; from people managing changes to those aiming to improve the status quo.

name: Rupam Tandon
bio: Rupam Tandon is a seasoned financial services leader and Certified Independent Director with over 30 years of global experience across investment banking and strategic advisory. A recognized governance expert, she specializes in bridging established corporate best practices with the agility needs of startups. Rupam champions ethical leadership and sustainable value creation, shaping governance discourse for boards and leadership teams worldwide.

name: Sameer Kochhar
bio: Reforms historian and author of the best-seller ModiNomics, Sameer Kochhar is Chairman, SKOCH Group. He is a passionate advocate of social, digital, and financial inclusion and is a foremost expert on governance and inclusive growth. His work has been acclaimed globally and endorsed by Narendra Modi, M. Venkaiah Naidu, Manmohan Singh, Arun Jaitley, P. Chidambaram, Yashwant Sinha, C. Rangarajan and Montek Singh Ahluwalia. In his thinking, writings, and activities, his profound admiration for India’s economic reforms and, by extension, those outstanding personalities who strive to make these reforms more meaningful and broad-based comes out clearly and unambiguously. He has published over 17 volumes, the most notable being India 2030: A Socio-Economic Paradigm; ModiNomics; Defeating Poverty: Jan Dhan and Beyond; and Modi’s Odyssey: Digital India, Developed India.

name: Shilpa Bhasin Mehra
bio: About the Author - Shilpa Bhasin Mehra has over 30 years of legal experience in the UAE. She has been the Head of Legal at global companies, as is now an independent legal consultant. Shilpa is the recipient of many awards for legal excellence and writing skills. She was also awarded the UAE Golden Visa in 2022 for her intellectual contributions. Shilpa lives in Dubai with her husband and two sons.

name: Dr Tania Dehury
bio: Dr Tania Dehury, PhD, MBA (Finance), is a distinguished author, thought leader, and boardroom advisor whose career spans over two decades across the domains of enterprise risk management, ESG strategy, and corporate governance. As Head of Risk Management and Business Continuity at Soudah Development, a flagship initiative under Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund (PIF), he has been instrumental in shaping resilient and future-ready risk frameworks. His earlier leadership roles at Al Rajhi Bank and Saudi National Bank saw the successful implementation of Risk Management Strategies, ICAAP, Risk Appetite Frameworks, GRC Systems, and ISO Standards for Risk and Business Continuity. A Certified Independent Director from the Indian Institute of Corporate Affairs (IICA) and a Fellow of the Institute of Directors (IoD), New Delhi, Dr. Dehury has pursued global programs from MIT, HEC Paris, and IESE Business School, Barcelona. He also holds certified credentials in ESG, Climate Risk, Private Equity, and Venture Capital from TCFD, UNITAR, the World Bank, and Imperial Business School London. Blending academic depth with real-world boardroom insight, Dr. Dehury champions a new vision of ethical leadership, strategic governance, and corporate resilience.

name: Punam Kumari
bio: Professor Punam Kumari is a distinguished Professor at Jawaharlal Nehru University, New Delhi, with over 23 years of teaching experience. After completing her undergraduate degree at Women’s College, Ranchi, Prof. Punam moved to JNU for higher studies, where she earned her Ph.D. Her teaching career began with stints at colleges in Uttar Pradesh and Rajasthan after she was selected by the State Service Commissions. She was also offered a lectureship by the University of California, Davis, USA.

name: Sharad Goyal
bio: Sharad Goyal is a Chartered Accountant with 20 years of experience in public accounting and consulting. For over 12 years he worked with Deloitte, including 3 years’ secondment with Deloitte, Japan. He is also a Registered Valuer.

name: Sarita  Salwan
bio: Sarita Salwan is Norway-based travel agent and DJ, born in Norway and brought up both in Norway and India. The author spent her schooling years in Dalhousie and pursued her MA in Human Resources and Marketing from a private management institute in Delhi. Sarita has successfully organised events, and introduced well-known Indian stand-up comedians, including Amit Tandon, to Oslo’s audiences. In her free time, she loves learning tarot, sipping chai with her teenage daughter and gossiping, just a bit. The Good Divorce: It’s Not What you Think is her debut book. Connect with the author on: Instagram: @sarita__salwan email: info@saritasalwan.com

name: Alok Misra
bio: CA. Alok Misra, a distinguished professional with over 2 decades of expertise, is the esteemed founder and managing partner of Alok Misra & Co., Chartered Accountants. His comprehensive practice spans across diverse domains, specializing in taxation, corporate laws, audit, advisory, FCRA, and more. Alok Misra holds the esteemed title of a fellow member of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI), showcasing his commitment to excellence. Additionally, he is also a Company Secretary from the Institute of Companies Secretaries of India and a Certified Information System Auditor from ICAI.Throughout his illustrious career, Alok has been a driving force in the realms of corporate governance, tax advisory, and audit & assurance services. Alok Misra is also recognized as the visionary promoter of "Vanprastha Resorts," a heaven of Yoga nestled in the Himalayas.

name: Dr Gautam Unny
bio: Dr Gautam Unny founded the Amrita Pet Care Clinic in New Delhi over thirty years ago with a vision for selfless animal care, guided by his Guru, AMMA, the hugging saint. He combines scientific expertise with compassionate client communication, laying the foundation for a successful practice. Dr. Unny has inspired generations of pet owners and veterinarians, nurturing young professionals to carry on his legacy. He has authored numerous books and articles on pet care and frequently appears in podcasts to educate others. Dr Unny exemplifies the integration of advanced technology with compassion and vision.

name: Dr Amit Nagpal
bio: Dr Amit Nagpal's life revolves around stories. From Marketer to Professor to Storyteller, six words tell his life story. He is President & Co-Founder of Bloggers Alliance. Professionally he works in the domain of digital & brand storytelling. Personally, he is passionate about applications of storytelling.

name: Manish Chaturvedi
bio: Manish Chaturvedi is a seasoned finance professional with a wealth of experience across diverse roles, blending strategic thinking with profound insights from Indian scriptures. With a deep passion for leadership and organizational transformation, he seamlessly integrates timeless wisdom with contemporary corporate challenges.

name: Mohua Chinappa
bio: Over the past 15+ years, Mohua Chinappa has held leadership positions as a Public. Relations/Corporate Communications specialist in top agencies, such as Brandcomm, HCL, ITC and Genesis PR. Currently, she hosts The Mohua Show, a podcast about unsung heroes, available on Apple, Google and Spotify.

name: Arjun Mitra
bio: Arjun Mitra is a student, born and raised in California. He specializes in crafting narratives that explore romance, comedy, and tragedy, often highlighting LGBTQ+ characters and relationships. In 2024, he served as a staff writer for the M-A Chronicle. When not writing, he enjoys playing video games, baking, and watching movies with his mother and cat.

name: Naina Pachnanda
bio: Naina Pachnanda is a lawyer working with Invest India, the National Investment Promotion and Facilitation Agency of India. She has completed her B.A. LL.B (Hons) from the West Bengal National University of Juridical Sciences ( NUJS) Kolkata in 2014. She is the author of the book ‘ A New India’, a book of patriotic poetry, based on the schemes of the Government of India. As a lawyer, she has practiced across various forums including the Supreme Court of India, the High Court of Delhi, Tribunals and District Courts as well as dealt with domestic arbitrations. This apart, she has published various articles on prominent topics of law and is also an Editor of the India Law Journal. She is a keen sports woman, proficient in piano and an enthusiastic tarot card reader.

name: Falguni Desai
bio: Falguni Desai, a seasoned technology leader with 23 years of experience, has been driving innovation and transformation since January 2000. As a Chief Technology Officer, she led the development of cutting-edge products and strengthened existing platforms for scalability and resilience. With a unique ability to bridge business and technology, she ensures sustainable growth and long-term impact.
